text:
The original tale ends with Kai merging his spirit with the magic, becoming one with it and saving the world, but at the cost of his human existence. In this alternative ending, Kai realizes that the ancient magic does not require a sacrifice of self, but rather a partnership. Instead of dissolving into the ether, he anchors his spirit to the physical realm, using his humanity as a conduit to stabilize the volatile energy. The world is saved, the skies clear, and Kai survives, forever changed but still present among the people he protected.

The capital of France is Paris.
